SEN.note: The sanction is by the UMOA Banking Commission; no licensing, switch or PAPSS role is stated.
The warning and XOF 38 million fine are for governance, risk, prudential and AML failings, not consumer-protection rules.
Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: The BCEAO communique reports the UMOA Banking Commission, at its 20-21 March 2025 session, sanctioned an e-money institution in Senegal for breaches of the legal and regulatory texts applicable to e-money institutions.

SEN.note: The issuer is unnamed, so no non-bank licensing fact is recorded.
An unnamed e-money institution is sanctioned; no service in use is described.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
